## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

fix issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/30322


## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

For requests that need to fetch KV cache from HiCache, we mark them first and skip send_metadata. After load_back completes, we re‑perform the match check, and only then call send_metadata.
